title: Atmospheric Dispersion Surrogate Research: Final Research Closure and No-Go Assessment
description: This release records the closure of the generic AERMOD surrogate product objective on 23 October 2026. Early frozen Phase2H tests showed genuine same-domain field improvements but persistent errors in controlling concentration peaks. The later Gen2 and Gen3 programme investigated physical representation, generalization, applicability, regulatory-style routing and alternative predictive designs. The terminal V16 neural-field model passed its blocked 2019 tests but failed eight of ten frozen gate families on selected spent 2025 transfer cases. A subsequent wind-reference-height diagnostic revealed a material computational weakness without producing an acceptable model. The final governed assessment retained a practical no-go for the unchanged generic formulation. The archive preserves positive and negative results and does not claim that all dispersion surrogates are impossible, or that any surrogate is regulatory-equivalent to AERMOD. The full narrative is in RESEARCH_CLOSURE_2026-10-23.md.
